title: Freestanding Makeup Mirror 8-Inch Double Faced 2X Solid Brass | Pink | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom grooming routine with a freestanding make-up mirror featuring an 8-Inch double faced mirror and 2X magnification for detailed viewing in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality.

  • Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 25 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass construction: crafted from brass with a heavy base to help prevent tipping
  • Surface protection: felt pad helps prevent scratching on surfaces
  • Style fit: traditional look that complements traditional bathroom hardware, classic bath accessories, and heritage bathroom fixtures

Specs

  • Category: Make-Up Mirrors
  • Mirror diameter: 8-Inch
  • Material: Brass
  • Mounting type: Freestanding
  • Dimensions: 10.5-Inch L x 10.5-Inch W
  • Weight: 13.6 lb
  • Included: Make-up mirror
  • Assembly required: Yes
  • including statement colors

_previous.title: Adjustable Height Floor Standing Make-Up Mirror 8 Inch Diameter with 2X Magnification
_previous.description: Elegantly and efficiently designed, this floor standing 2 sided magnification mirror is an easy solution for your daily make-up or shaving routine.  The dual-sided mirror features a clear magnification for those close-up applications on one side and a 1x magnification on the opposite side for a quick all around check at any angle.  With classic accents, this free-standing vanity mirror is the crowning touch to your bathroom accessories.
